passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I jump with a rope, and I count my jumps.
phrases.ko: 나는 줄을 가지고 뛰고, 뛴 횟수를 세요.

phrases.en: We do it in gym class.
Jump rope makes me strong, and it is fun.
I count to twenty and then I rest.
phrases.ko: 나는 스무 개까지 세고 나서 쉬어요.

phrases.en: A fast jump is hard, so I start slowly.
phrases.ko: 빨리 뛰는 것은 어려워서 나는 천천히 시작해요.

phrases.en: In gym class we each take a turn.
phrases.ko: 체육 시간에 우리는 각자 차례를 가져요.

phrases.en: I feel strong after this fun class.
phrases.ko: 이 재미있는 수업 후에 나는 튼튼해진 느낌이 들어요.

phrases.en: I like jump rope because I can do it anywhere.
phrases.ko: 어디서나 할 수 있어서 나는 줄넘기를 좋아해요.

full_passage_spoken: I also like jump rope. I jump with a rope, and I count my jumps. I try to jump fast. We do it in gym class. I wait for my turn. Jump rope makes me strong, and it is fun. I count to twenty and then I rest. A fast jump is hard, so I start slowly. In gym class we each take a turn. I feel strong after this fun class. I like jump rope because I can do it anywhere.
